Can you migrate from my current platform?
Yes. We migrate from Magento, BigCommerce, Squarespace, Wix, and custom platforms — preserving product data, customer accounts, order history, and SEO rankings with proper redirects.

We audit your current funnel (analytics, heatmaps, session recordings), identify drop-off points, and redesign the shopping experience — from product discovery through checkout. Most custom rebuilds see 40–100% conversion rate improvement.

Yes. We build performant stores with faceted search, lazy loading, and CDN-served assets that handle catalogs of any size. We've built stores with 50,000+ SKUs.
